title: Prove a cold first session registers on a small machine
text: Source tests prove the resident listens before it loads the evaluator, that a loading, never-listening or exiting resident holds the hook client no longer than YOKE_HOOK_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_MS (capped below the shortest harness hook timeout), and that a spent budget answers hook_budget_exhausted with yoke hook resident restart as recovery. yoke setup now restarts the resident before the first harness session. Still owed: a live check on a 2 vCPU, 1 GB Linux test machine that Cursor's first turn after yoke setup registers its session, and that a first hook after the ten-minute idle retirement answers inside Cursor's 30-second hook timeout.
